api.desc: create mermaid node on the whiteboard.

body.plant_uml_code:
sequenceDiagram
  participant B as 浏览器
  participant I as Ingest
  participant D as PostgreSQL
  participant W as 聚合worker
  B->>I: 有限批次 events
  I->>D: 校验后 INSERT去重，COMMIT
  D-->>I: 已持久化
  I-->>B: ACK accepted / duplicate
  W->>D: 锁未聚合行 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  W->>D: UV去重 + daily upsert + aggregated标记，同事务
  alt worker在commit前崩溃
    D-->>W: 整批回滚，下次仍能认领未处理行
  else commit后崩溃
    D-->>W: 指标和处理标记已保存，不重复累计
  end

data.description: will call whiteboard open api to update content.
